responsibility: Validates that impl associated items are compatible with the trait items they implement by comparing method structure, generics, receivers, predicates, async behavior, associated types, and consts, and by constructing the trait-to-impl predicate environment used for entailment and diagnostics. It is responsible for rejecting incompatible impl associated items before later queries resolve or inline their instances, including cases where an impl method has a signature that does not match the trait method such as an unexpected `self` receiver, wrong argument list, incompatible predicates, or mismatched associated const/type definitions.
